marta (CS): Quick heads-up — Concordia reported a regression after last week's embed deploy. Top-1 precision on their rerank evaluation dropped ~10% on prod. They opened INC-4239. Renewal in ~3w, high risk. @ravi (PM) please triage :warning:

triage-bot: Ticket INC-4239 created by Concordia support. SLA: 48h. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4239

sam (Sales): Yikes — customer already flagged at CSM call. If this isn't addressed quickly they'll push renewal. Anything we can do to buy time? :eyes:

ravi (PM): Thanks for flagging. Marta — can you paste the before/after metrics and a couple of canonical queries that fail? Also whether they use cosine or dot, and which embedding model they were pinned to before.

marta (CS): Copying the snippet from their support ticket:

"Query: 'how to reset billing'
Top-1 result before (embed-v1): 'Billing > Reset payment method' (score 0.78)
Top-1 result after (embed-lite-2q): 'Account overview' (score 0.61)

We ran a 2k-query eval on their curated test set: top-1 recall 0.68 -> 0.59"

jordan (Eng): Interesting. Did we switch to a quantized model for cost reasons? embed-lite-2q sounds like it. Two immediate hypotheses: (1) model vector geometry changed (cosine vs dot scaling), (2) normalization / post-process changed. Can you share the exact call they make (params) and the indexing config?

marta (CS): They use the Redwood embeddings endpoint with cosine similarity and index stored with HNSW (ef=200). Sample call (redacted customer ID):

```json
{
  "model": "embed-lite-2q",
  "input": "how to reset billing",
  "normalize": false,
  "index": "concordia_docs",
  "similarity": "cosine"
}
```

jordan (Eng): normalize=false could matter. embed-v1 might have produced L2-normalized vectors by default; if embed-lite-2q changed norms that will change ranking under cosine unless you normalize server-side. Quick mitigation options:
- Re-pin Concordia to embed-v1 for their workspace (fast, P0 rollback).
- Add an on-read normalization step in the rerank pipeline (cheap patch).
- Force cross-encoder fallback for top-K (expensive but high-quality).

I'll run a 500-sample A/B with and without normalization and report MRR/Precision delta.

ravi (PM): Prioritization: this is blocking a renewal — mark as P1. Acceptance criteria for fix: top-1 recall on Concordia's test set returns to within 2% of pre-deploy baseline and no significant latency regression (>100ms). If rollback, ensure we have an automated eval and a rollout plan.

marta (CS): Created backlog ticket PROD-2897 and linked INC-4239 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-2897. Added customer examples and raw testset link (s3://redwood-customer-data/concordia/evals/2024-11-15). Noted renewal date and CS escalation notes.

sam (Sales): Please cc me on the ticket. If we need to offer a short-term credit or dedicated support hours, let's decide quick. I'll prep an account note.

jordan (Eng): I'll start with an A/B on normalization and a quick revert test. Need access to their 500-sample eval in prod redshift — @marta can you grant temporary access or paste a small CSV here?

marta (CS): Granting access now for "jordan@redwood". CSV sample uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/concordia-samples/500.csv

ravi (PM): Roadmap decision path: if normalization fix resolves >80% of gap, we'll ship as rollback-less hotfix (low-risk). If it doesn't, escalate to model-pin rollback and then longer-term plan: add automatic eval checks per customer on model changes.

triage-bot: Severity escalated to P1 by ravi. SLA timer started.

jordan (Eng): I'll post results by EOD tomorrow. If I can reproduce locally I'll open a PR for the normalization flag and a small integration test that runs the customer's 500 sample set in CI.

marta (CS): Thanks. Concordia wants weekly updates. I'll schedule a touchpoint and share the ticket link with them. :rocket:

sam (Sales): Thanks team — keeping an eye. Ping me if we need to offer credits.

ravi (PM): Thanks everyone. Next: Jordan to post A/B numbers; Marta to keep customer informed; Sam to prep commercial cover. We'll reconvene after eng numbers. :white_check_mark:
